cases.notes: Both adapter conditions show two yellow pears and a blue vase. Base conditions have incorrect count and flat illustration. Strong adapter effect already occurs without trigger; selective activation and intended oil-paint appearance are not established.

Both adapter conditions show two pears and a dark blue vase; base conditions have grids and incorrect arrangements. Composition improves locally. Similar effects without trigger do not establish token-specific control.

All conditions have divided panels. Adapter/plain substitutes red angular geometry and extra cones; adapter/trigger includes a red cube plus an extra red cone and white cone in separate panels. Count/layout and regression criteria fail.

Both adapter conditions show one red cube and one white cone. Base variants substitute red conical/angular forms. This seed is coherent, but activation remains unestablished and the other regression seed still fails.

review.limitations: Small two-prompt/two-seed pilot, disclosed labels, no independent calibrated evaluator and no new render in this review. False means the criterion is not established or an observed failure exists. Diffusers and ComfyUI samplers differ. This review does not assert human independence, generalized capability or product completion.
review.method: Direct assistant visual inspection in this session of all 16 condition-labeled images via the two contact sheets and the stock ComfyUI pair; hash/lineage and technical assessment revalidation. Same seed compared within each runtime.
review.notes: Reject the current candidate for production: one regression seed has extra objects/panels; both stock ComfyUI images show only one pear instead of two; reliable trigger-specific control is unresolved. Runtime compatibility passes only for the recorded export pair. The user shelved the human-only gate; further engineering and testing remain the assistant responsibility.

scope: Actual assistant evidence review and policy revalidation; no retraining, rendering, activation or human review
